name: Time Entry Agent (Dynamics 365 Project Operations)
short_description: The Time Entry agent, part of the Time and Expense Agent in Dynamics 365 Project Operations, drafts weekly time entries from resource assignments and Outlook calendar data, reminds users in Microsoft Teams to submit them and can support approvals.

evidence.quote: We've got a time entry agent that can go and automate the creation of all through a different sort of time entries
